question: What was the 24-hour rainfall depth at Tistung?
answer:
The 24-hour rainfall depth recorded at Tistung was 540 mm [1].

[1] 1970_Marahatta_Relating_Hydrological_Extremes_with_Area_A_Case_on_Extreme_F_W2121362616.pdf, p. 2: "The 24-hour rainfall depth of 540 mm at Tistung and 482 mm at Ghantemadi were recorded in morning hours of 20th July."
